summary: Primerica, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment and restatement of its $200 million unsecured revolving credit facility, extending maturity to June 2, 2031 and adjusting margins and covenants. No amounts were outstanding at entry. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility for general corporate purposes, not a special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return. The filing reflects ordinary debt management without any extraordinary or event-driven implications for shareholders.
